name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP request to /Glovia_SalesOrder containing valid Salesforce outbound message notification with standard order type (e.g., YORB).
expected_outcome: Message accepted with HTTP 202/200; properties populated (InputPayload); router directs to SalesOrder branch (CallActivity_102); mapping executes; generic headers script (CallActivity_13) enriches message log; process terminates cleanly at EndEvent_2.
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 (Route 1), CallActivity_4, CallActivity_102, CallActivity_13, and EndEvent_2.

name: Sales Order Return Processing
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with order payload satisfying return condition ({{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}}).
expected_outcome: Router selects branch SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 (SO Return create); generic headers logged; process ends cleanly at EndEvent_9.

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP request where giic_OrderTypeCode__c matches neither sales order nor return routing condition expressions.
expected_outcome: Router defaults to SequenceFlow_110 targeting EndEvent_11; EscalationEndEvent triggered with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default route and EndEvent_11 escalation event execution.

name: Mapping Failure & Exception Subprocess Handling
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with malformed inner XML or invalid schema that triggers an exception in Message Mapping (CallActivity_102).
expected_outcome: Flow catches error via StartEvent_92 in SubProcess_91; CallActivity_97 restores original payload from ${property.InputPayload}; CallActivity_100 executes Log_Payload (1).gsh; terminates at EndEvent_95.
validates: SubProcess_91, StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97, CallActivity_100, and EndEvent_95.

name: Transient Transport Failure and Timeout Simulation
trigger: Network interruption or downstream connectivity failure causing timeout during adapter dispatch.
expected_outcome: Client detects request timeout; exception handling path or adapter timeout status validated.
validates: SOAP receiver/adapter resilience under network timeout conditions.

name: Unauthorized Sender Invocation (Role-Based Access Validation)
trigger: Inbound SOAP invocation without required 'ESBMessaging.send' role or invalid client credentials.
expected_outcome: Runtime rejects request with HTTP 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden before entering Process_1.
